title: Extracellular vesicles and their role in neurodegenerative diseases
title_zh: 细胞外囊泡及其在神经退行性疾病中的作用
abstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are membrane-bound nanoparticles that enable intercellular communication in the nervous system by transferring proteins, lipids and nucleic acids between cells. In neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs), evidence from cellular and animal models, together with emerging human data, implicates EVs in several interconnected processes: altered vesicle biogenesis and endolysosomal trafficking; selective loading of pathogenic cargoes (including amyloid-β, tau, α-synuclein, TDP43 and PrPSc); and dissemination of misfolded proteins in ways consistent with prion-like seeding and spread. EVs also modulate neuroinflammation by relaying cytokines and regulatory microRNAs among neurons, glia and the neurovascular unit and by engaging the blood–brain barrier to shape CNS–periphery crosstalk. These same properties underpin a growing translational interest: brain-derived EV populations in blood and other biofluids offer a minimally invasive window into early pathology and disease trajectories, and native or engineered EVs are being developed as delivery vehicles or as targets to curb pathological propagation. This Review integrates mechanistic and clinical advances, highlights key sources of biological and methodological variability, and defines priorities for standardization, cell-of-origin assignment and clinical validation required to realize EV-based diagnostics and therapeutics for NDDs. Extracellular vesicles are membrane-bound particles that are involved in intercellular communication in the nervous system. In this Review, Spiers, Broatch and Hill examine the role of these vesicles in the biology, diagnosis and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: 细胞外囊泡（EVs）是具有膜包被的纳米颗粒，可通过在细胞之间转移蛋白质、脂质和核酸来促进神经系统内的细胞间通讯。在神经退行性疾病（NDDs）中，细胞和动物模型的证据以及新兴的人类数据表明，EVs 涉及多个相互关联的过程：囊泡发生和内体溶酶体转运改变；致病性货物（包括淀粉样 β 斑蛋白、tau 蛋白、α-突触核蛋白、TDP43 和 PrPSc）的选择性加载；以及与朊病毒样播种和扩散一致的错误折叠蛋白传播。EVs 还通过在神经元、胶质细胞和神经血管单位之间传递细胞因子和调节性微小 RNA 来调节神经炎症，并通过参与血脑屏障来塑造中枢神经系统—外周相互作用。这些特性也支撑着不断增长的转化兴趣：血液和其他生物液体中源自脑的 EV 群体为早期病理和疾病轨迹提供了微创窗口，天然或工程化 EVs 正在被开发为递送载体或抑制病理传播的靶点。本综述整合了机制和临床进展，强调了生物学和方法学变异的关键来源，并为实现 NDDs 的 EV 基础诊断和治疗，界定了标准化、细胞来源分配和临床验证所需的优先事项。细胞外囊泡是参与神经系统内细胞间通讯的膜包被颗粒。在本综述中，Spiers、Broatch 和 Hill 考察了这些囊泡在神经退行性疾病生物学、诊断和治疗中的作用。
